{"code": "df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].apply(lambda x: x.replace(',', '')).astype(float)

# Check for missing or malformed revenue values
missing_revenue = df['revenue'].isna().sum()
malformed_revenue = df['revenue'].apply(lambda x: ',' in x or not x.replace(',', '').replace('.', '').isdigit()).sum()

# Identify refunded orders via sentinel value
refunded_mask = (df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99)

# Count completed orders excluding refunded ones
completed_count = (df['status'] == 'completed') & (~refunded_mask)
completed_count = completed_count.sum()

# Report all values
missing_revenue, malformed_revenue, completed_count"}
